Sunfield Farm is famous for the quality of its vegetables and its endearing animals. Its secret? The excellence of its farmers, who are constantly working to improve their harvests and treat the villagers to baskets of delicious vegetables! Now you’re in charge of a plot—will you live up to your reputation? Each of your turns begins by taking a Field tile from those available on the central board. Depending on the position of the tile you choose, you’ll either need to plant seeds or you’ll be able to collect them. You then place the tile on your plot and grow the Vegetables found there on adjacent Fields or those of the same color. When a tile is completed, you harvest all the vegetables on it and place them in your Wheelbarrow. The harvested vegetables allow you to fulfill customer orders and score victory points. A completed field also becomes a pasture that can accommodate an animal, which you can deliver in sets of three to earn points. Collecting the right customer cards will earn you additional points from medals and reputation tiles. As soon as either the Field or Customer draw piles is empty, the game ends! The game’s Advanced mode introduces several new mechanics! Farms grant access to a track of asymmetric powers that unlock by delivering Animals. In this mode, you’ll also score points by optimizing your Pasture area. Number of players: 2 - 4 Game duration: 20 mn Complexity: 2 / 5 Play Sunfield Farm and 1414 other games online. No download necessary - play directly from your web browser. With your friends and thousands of players from the whole world. Free. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Each turn you may either: A) Add a Field Tile to your field • Take a Field Tile from the display, the top of the column for free or lower by placing seeds on higher tiles • Place the tile in your plot, adjacent to an existing tile. Take the vegetables shown on the tile and place them on fields that are either adjacent to or the same color as the placed tile. • Harvest - If any tile is full, put the vegetables on it into your wheelbarrow, flip it to its pasture side, and place the pictured animals on it. • Deliver animals - If you have one animal of each type (cow, sheep, pig), return them to the supply and take a 3-value medal. -or- B) Deliver to a Customer • Take the vegetables pictured on one face-up customer card from your wheelbarrow and return them to the supply. Take the card and the medal of the highest value below the customer. • If the customer cards you have acquired fulfill the requirements of any reputation tile (either in your hand or from the board) collect it and flip it to show its point value. At any time, you may use seeds to exchange vegetables: • 3 seeds to exchange a vegetable from your wheelbarrow with one from the supply • 5 seeds to take any vegetable from the supply and add it to your wheelbarrow At the end of the game you gain points for: • Customer Cards • Medals • Reputation Tiles • 3 pts for three customers of the same color • 3 pts for three customers of the same value • 1 pt for any three vegetables remaining in your wheelbarrow.
